caveats_c3_4_honest.claim: ensure_runtime_dep() runs BEFORE the entry-exists check in install.hexa main(). If `hx install qmirror` cascades a failing build hook (qmirror's own install.hexa), nexus install proceeds anyway (non-fatal WARN). User may end up with nexus shim but no functional qmirror — surfaces only when nexus/modules/qmirror/* runtime hits a `qmirror not found`.
caveats_c3_4_honest.mitigation: non-fatal-by-design (raw#10 — avoid cascading aborts). Documented in install.hexa comment block. Hard-fail mode could be opt-in via NEXUS_INSTALL_STRICT_DEPS=1 env (future).

caveats_c3_4_honest.claim: End-to-end `rm -rf ~/.hx/packages/nexus && hx install nexus` was NOT executed in this cycle (sandbox + raw#15 cost-zero). Verification is static (syntax match against existing fns + sister hexa.toml files). First fresh install on a clean machine is the integration test.
